# 2 Baruch Chapter 76 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**1** After all these things, I, Baruch, went back to the people and told them everything about this vision, urging them at length.

**2** I said to them: "I am going to join my fathers — that is the way of all living people. But do not abandon the way of the Lord."

**3** "The Lord is faithful and will pay each person back according to their deeds."

**4** "Do not be afraid of the disaster that has gripped you — it will pass. Do not be anxious about the troubles that have come upon you — the Mighty One will deliver you."

**5** When I had finished speaking all these words to the people, I, Baruch, took my leave of them.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Prioritizes clarity and natural English flow while preserving the theological and narrative content of the Syriac source.*
